title: Arcana Core Field: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose missing Arcana records by checking providers, ids, and optional loading boundaries.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a record vanishes, first check the provider registration and required mod id. A missing optional addon should hide enrichment, not crash the base route.

blocks.title: Shrink The Test
blocks.body: Test a single definition in Arcana Core before testing every consuming surface. One stable record is easier to debug than a full route.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Fix ids, then provider registration, then UI links. Changing all three at once can make a bad bridge look like bad content.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
